description: A resource and newsletter for working commercial and specialty insurance underwriters.
image_alt: Institute of Underwriting — a resource for commercial and specialty insurance underwriters.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team consists of industry veterans producing technical content for commercial and specialty underwriters.

editorial.testing: All our content is peer-reviewed by active practitioners in the commercial and specialty insurance sectors.
editorial.funding: The Institute of Underwriting is a free resource funded entirely through insurtech sponsorships. We are not a professional body or an accrediting institute.
editorial.corrections: We strive for accuracy. If you find an error, please contact us, and we will update the piece with a correction notice.
